case_number: 2025 INSC 385; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (@Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.7422 of 2023)
summary: High Court direction to CBI to register case in bail application challenged; prior precedents cited to establish limits of judicial jurisdiction in bail matters; State opposed only procedural overreach, not bail grant; Section 161 Cr.P.C. statement unverified; no extraordinary circumstances warranting CBI probe shown; jurisdictional overreach in bail context impermissible; impugned order set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order set aside to the extent of directions to CBI; bail not disturbed.
